title: The Passive role in the talk
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：passive　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 passive 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the counsellor wrote of ① a passive role in the talk in the journal, and everybody in the garden said at once that it was ② so passive that nobody in the garden would go near it. Three evenings on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the counsellor, who never explained anything, had done it at once and gone home; it was the passive ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the passive role in the talk that anybody there had ever seen, or so the journal for June 1951 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too passive to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the passive ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a passive voice in the sentence, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as passive as the voice in the sentence they had once had in the old garden. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was passive or not, and he said so.

By 1964 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something passive, and nothing besides. The listener from the next garden called the whole plan ⑧ quite passive; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the passive ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1967, in the rain, she wrote of another passive role in the talk in the same journal, and the work, which took two evenings, seemed ⑨ no less passive than anybody had expected. ⑩ The passive voice in the sentence that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1969, was the one she could never quite name; the passive ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 被动（前置定语 a passive role in the talk：1957 年谈心人在心记里记下的那件被动的角色）
B. adj. 被动／消极（两处加强说法：so passive that … 与 no less passive than …）
C. adj. 被动／消极（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 被动（表语 too passive to do：母亲觉得它太被动，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 消极（前置定语 a passive voice in the sentence：叔叔把整件事称作一桩消极的被动语态）
F. adj. 消极（同级比较 as passive as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩句子里的被动语态相比）
G. adj. 消极（后置定语 something passive：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 消极（受程度副词修饰 quite passive：那位倾听者的评价）

items.q: a passive role in the talk
the passive role in the talk that
a passive voice in the sentence
The passive voice in the sentence that

answers.why: passive 意为“被动”，1957 年谈心人在心记里记下的是“一件被动的角色”，此处作前置定语 a passive role in the talk。
passive 意为“被动”，此处用 so passive that 结构，说它被动到小园里没人敢靠近。
passive 意为“被动”，心记上 六月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的被动谈话中的被动角色，等于最高级的说法。
passive 意为“被动”，母亲认为这件东西“太被动了，谁也用不上”，too passive to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
passive 意为“消极”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩消极的被动语态”，此处作前置定语 a passive voice in the sentence。
passive 意为“消极”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩句子里的被动语态一样消极”，同级比较用 as passive as。
passive 意为“消极”，心记上那半行字要的是“消极的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something passive。
passive 意为“消极”，邻小园来的那位倾听者认为这套计划“相当消极”，quite 修饰原级 passive。
passive 意为“消极”，no less passive than 表示“其消极不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之消极不亚于任何人的预料。
passive 意为“消极”，母亲 1969 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的消极被动语态”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年，谈心人在心记里记下了一件被动的角色。（a passive role in the talk）
它被动到小园里没有一个人敢靠近。（so passive that …）
母亲觉得它太被动，谁也用不上。（too passive to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩消极的被动语态。（a passive voice in the sentence）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩句子里的被动语态一样消极。（as passive as …）
到了 1964 年，心记上只剩半行字：要的是一件消极的东西。（something passive）
answers: In 1957 the counsellor wrote of a passive role in the talk in the journal.
It was so passive that nobody in the garden would go near it.
My mother thought it too passive to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a passive voice in the sentence.
He said nobody would call it as passive as the voice in the sentence they had once had.
By 1964 the journal asked for nothing but something passive.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 passive 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the counsellor wrote of a passive role in the talk in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the passive role in the talk that anybody there had ever seen, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too passive to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a passive voice in the sentence, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next garden called the plan quite passive, and everybody laughed.
The passive ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
